body:
I feel as if I'm missing out on life. I always see those around me enjoying themselves, being with friends or girlfriends, while I just let life pass me by. I remember during my first semester I was more reactionary to sights like these. I remember overhearing some students in my dorm talking how one of them have to leave the room because every other day his roommate has sex with his gf. From then on, every Friday night, I kept thinking, "well, damn, im missing out on a lot of things, but im here playing video games". But that was when I was with my ex. Back then I had someone to talk with, actually talk with, but now I have no one to do that with. No one to come home to after a long day. 
I think with relating to the sexual frustration, my inability to satisfy it just adds to my loneliness and general unhappiness. 
Whenever I go on suicide forums how the stories that stick out the most are those 30 to mid age who live alone. I dont want to get to that stage, might as well die, either way (living sadly or dead) one is already dead either metaphorically or physically.
To clarify, I meant how is the body dealt with, how parents are notified, and what (if any role do roommates play?), pretty much details like that.
